about: The adventure's stages, all of VS's main stages that need no DLC: VS's own stages (map, enemies, bosses, music) played from the player's game, each stored again under a free stage slot of the adventure. Like VS's own adventures, a stage opens on the adventure's stage list once the goal of the stage before it is met (VS's adventure progress: the goal, its gold and the unlock show at the end of a run). order = position in the stage list.

columns.slot: free VS StageType key it is stored under in the adventure's stage data (none of these is a stage of the game or its DLC: TEST, TESTONE, ADV_0001TEST, ENTRANCE, CASTLE)
columns.vsStage: VS StageType whose stage (tiles, waves, bosses) it plays
columns.name: stage name in the adventure
columns.description: stage description in the stage list
columns.unlockedBy: start, or the stages row whose goal unlocks it
columns.minutes: the stage's length in VS minutes
columns.goalMinutes: minutes to survive in this stage to meet its goal
columns.goalType: VS AdventureAchievementType the goal is kept under (in this adventure's own save; its text is the goal column, never VS's)
columns.goal: the progress goal shown in the adventure (its gold prize: goalGold)

rows.name: Mad Forest
rows.description: Two ROUNDS blobs wander into the Mad Forest. Pick your cards, build your gun, survive.
rows.goal: Survive 10 minutes in the Mad Forest.

rows.name: Inlaid Library
rows.description: Endless shelves and everything that crawls between them. The library runs sideways forever.
rows.goal: Survive 10 minutes in the Inlaid Library.

rows.name: Dairy Plant
rows.description: Pipes, tanks and the night shift. Mind the dark corners of the old plant.
rows.goal: Survive 10 minutes in the Dairy Plant.

rows.name: Gallo Tower
rows.description: One long way up. The tower runs up and down forever and the horde comes from both ends.

rows.name: Cappella Magna
rows.description: The great chapel at the end of the night. Last stop of the Vampire Rounds adventure.
